candidate.applies_to: versus_captured_output and versus_identity_replay comparisons for every layout; identity comparisons are trivially exact against themselves

identity_versus_captured.strict_equivalence_note: enforced via max_abs_error <= atol on the identity-versus-captured comparison, which at rtol=0 is exactly equivalent to zero isclose failures under the strict bound

evidence: calibration correctness records (pre-evaluation): identity-vs-captured max_abs=0; candidate-vs-identity nonzero in 3456/3456 comparisons, max 0.0029296875
bf16 8-bit mantissa: one rounding quantum is < 2^-7 relative; absolute 2^-8 bound fails at magnitudes >= 1
attempt-01 failure record: rank 0 only, layouts raw-01/02+padding-01/02, 2-6 elements of 16,613,376, max_abs exactly 2^-7, zero nonfinite, identity/m2/random passed
correctness_gate_amendment.reason: attempt-01 strict absolute gate blocked on isolated one-ulp bf16 flips inherent to placement-permuted FP8 grouped-GEMM/combine reordering

design.fresh_start_semantics: one torchrun process group per start; every start reloads all immutable artifacts and rebuilds weights before warmup
design.response_definition: start-level Q = mean of four paired block effects; each block effect is completion_fenced_us_per_forward(identity) - completion_fenced_us_per_forward(candidate)

timing.diagnostic_metric: same-device CUDA elapsed interval bracketing real runner.run
timing.schedule_algorithm: random.Random(seed + offset + block).shuffle over the frozen layout order; offset 0 for the primary pass, 1000003 for the diagnostic pass
